scope: CPU-only source, contract, test and retained evidence review of experimental joint budget / variable-length execution. No MLX import, GPU execution, model loading or service changes by reviewer.

checks.name: actual execution API
checks.detail: Real model forwards use equal-q bucket shapes and audited dense cache merge. No invented BatchGenerator vector-cap API. Padded control executes and counts padding; disposable padded state is never committed.

checks.name: budget and confidence semantics
checks.detail: Finite conditional versus cumulative contract, censored suffix, stable UID/generation, two committed histories N-2/N-1, dynamic active batch key, and immutable observations. CPU unit fixtures contain synthetic curves solely as algorithm tests, not benchmark measurements.

checks.name: transactional recovery
checks.detail: Original target and draft states are snapshotted and restored on exceptions/cancel. Success uses exact consumed-prefix replay. Hybrid execution remains single-row; public capability flags remain false and public worker does not import experimental session.

checks.name: complete work accounting
checks.detail: Draft, verify, replay and draft catch-up submissions and model token positions counted. Full-cycle timer includes host/statistical work and synchronized device state; verifier-only timer explicitly excludes draft. Kernel count remains null. 7 versus 12 verify positions and 30 versus 35 complete model-input positions are work controls, not milliseconds or mature-engine advantage.

checks.name: evidence gates
checks.detail: Four complete reports retain failures and strict accepted=false. Same-target draft labelled mechanism control; no trained head, held-out calibration, realistic acceleration or three-process claim. Real history case has no calibrated cost curve, explicitly disclosed.

checks.name: historical identity and privacy
checks.detail: Independently compared each public report to private raw: only absolute source-map keys normalized, all hash values and measurements identical. Final runtime hashes match current source; harness formatter-only followup separately recorded without rebinding executed hash.

checks.name: related diagnosis / contract / package scope
checks.detail: Logits diagnosis keeps complete raw inputs/logits private and reports numerical boundary without isolating a kernel or relaxing gate. Contract audit is CPU source-only. Package explicitly binds commit 766d6e1, not new joint code, release_ready=false, no publication, no weights/raw data in archives; generic path-rule text is not a private path.

independent_command.result: 21 passed; 2025 independent reference allocation comparisons included

resolved_findings.title: Absolute source paths in public joint reports
resolved_findings.resolution: Four raw reports retained privately; public source-map keys normalized to repository-relative paths only. Historical execution hashes preserved; future harness formatter fixed and separately identified.

limits: Static approval is not full Phase 3 section 4 acceptance.
Pretrained exact serial-native gate remains false; no tolerance relaxed.
No cost-calibrated held-out policy acceptance or latency/throughput advantage against MLX-LM/oMLX established.
No public worker integration, hybrid cross-row batch, sampling speculation, trained confidence head or production capability promotion.
Package evidence covers preceding fixed commit only.
